title: Public Creator Vanity Page
summary: Render a public server-side creator page from the canonical SESH-041 public creator handle resolution contract using the already-locked SESH-042 SESH_DB-only runtime composition.
invariants: The vanity page is server rendered and never statically enumerates creator handles.
The dynamic route handle is the only creator lookup input.
The page reuses createPublicSeshCreatorHandleResolutionAtRuntime and does not create a second persistence or identity composition path.
The page does not authenticate visitors and does not require session or RIVER_IDENTITY_DB.
Successful pages expose only canonical handle, displayName, and optional bio.
Canonical metadata uses the normalized handle returned by the public resolver.
Invalid handles and missing creators render a 404 response and are noindex.
Infrastructure or persistence unavailability renders a 503 response and is noindex.
Successful creator pages are indexable and use the canonical creator URL.
All vanity page responses use cache-control no-store at this stage.
The page exposes no SeshCreatorId, PrincipalId, account identity, session identity, CRM identity, persistence revision, timestamps, or storage metadata.
The page grants or implies no project ownership, collaborator, publishing, management, legal, copyright, account, authentication, or authorization rights.
This step introduces no handle availability oracle, release operation, rename operation, follow graph, messaging system, music publication state, or management relationship.
